digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge preview and reconcile command
propositions: Canonical preview must execute one ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit a manifest containing both arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift from that same pass without acquiring or mutating the pass lock.
Legacy reconcile-check must retain its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, diagnostic JSON artifact, and distinct behavior independent of preview.

The argparse parser must use allow_abbrev=False to reject undocumented prefix abbreviations and unknown options with exit code 2 before any repository or lock mutation, while documented legacy options remain valid.

Canonical preview and canonical sync must emit the same field-comparable manifest envelope, including exact applied/failed tally for canonical live, while legacy uncapped LIVE callers retain their historical tally-only no-manifest contract.
Legacy reconcile, library, MCP, and external helper workflows must retain their original observable behavior unchanged across all command shapes and execution paths.
